evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~444-446 °C, physically implausible versus all column temps 63-75 °C at 500 mbar; flat/insensitive, indicating sensor fault
Pinned at 63.4-63.5 °C for 20 min with no response, suggesting stuck/unresponsive condenser-region readings
Slow oscillatory wave (66→75→66 °C) propagating up the column rather than a settled profile
Reflux and distillate flows near zero and erratic (0-2 L/h) while FYI702 reports a steady ratio ~6-7, inconsistent with measured flows

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature check/calibration and a distillate composition (GC) sample; confirmation of whether the reflux splitter/pumps are actually running.
